notice: Required UI text and approved templates; values must come from validated runtime DTOs. This is not an implemented UI.

messages.landing.headline: Your purchase records, across inboxes.
messages.landing.description: Find receipts, see what you paid and what was refunded, and keep your purchase history organized. No bank connection needed.
messages.landing.betaAllowance: Free beta with a limited processing allowance. History imports use the same allowance. No card required.
messages.demo.banner: Example data. Nothing from your inbox.
messages.login.explanation: Signing in creates your private workspace. It does not connect your inbox.
messages.mailbox.title: Connect the inbox where you receive receipts.
messages.mailbox.permission: We ask for read-only access to this mailbox so we can look for purchase-related messages. This permission is broader than receipts alone. The app limits processing to purchase-related messages and cannot send or delete email with this connection.
messages.mailboxReadPermission: We ask for read-only access to the selected mailbox. This permission is broader than receipts alone. You review the import range before processing starts; connecting does not start an import.
messages.import.review.title: Review and start
messages.import.review.changeRequired: Processing settings have changed. Review the current details before continuing.
messages.import.review.originals: Originals stay in your email unless you enable a Drive archive.
messages.import.progress.ready: {recordCount} purchase records ready. Older history may still be importing.
messages.import.progress.older: Continuing through older emails in your chosen range.
messages.import.progress.background: You can close this page. The import will continue in the background.
messages.import.empty.recent: No recent purchase records found yet. Older history is still being checked.
messages.import.empty.complete: No matching purchase records found in this range. Check the covered inbox and dates, or add another inbox.
messages.import.completedWithIssues: Scan finished with {reviewCount} items needing attention.
messages.import.paused.budget: Processing is paused at the current allowance or service-capacity limit. Your existing records are still available.
messages.import.paused.auth: New receipt checks are paused. Reconnect this mailbox to continue.
messages.import.paused.service: Receipt processing is currently unavailable. You can still use the example and view existing records.
messages.home.spendingCaption: Based on connected receipts, not bank-verified.
messages.purchase.noPayment: No payment has been confirmed for these records.
messages.drive.offer: Save originals to your Google Drive
messages.drive.explanation: Create an archive in your own Drive. Only source documents that are still available can be saved.
messages.drive.permissions: The app can manage files it creates or that you explicitly share with it. It does not request access to your entire Drive.
messages.drive.failure: The purchase record is available, but its original could not be saved to Drive.
messages.drive.deletion: Deleting your app account does not delete the files in your Google Drive.
messages.recurring.change: This comparable charge changed from {previousAmount} to {currentAmount}.
messages.recurring.uncertain: These bills may not be directly comparable. Review the source amounts and billing terms.
messages.recurring.estimate: Estimated next payment date. Not a confirmed charge.
messages.privacy.pilot: Help evaluate the beta with optional, content-free usage events. No receipt values, merchants, email text, or search terms are collected for this measurement.
messages.privacy.pilotDeclined: Optional usage measurement is off. All product features remain available.
messages.release.unavailable: This feature is not available in this beta.
messages.import.reviewNeeded: Purchase documents were found, but some details need your review. No uncertain payments have been added to spending.

guards.landing.betaAllowance: Show only when hosted processing is actually available; place real remaining allowance in authenticated review.
guards.mailbox.permission: Applies to the approved read-only MVP scopes; source adapter must confirm it remains true.
guards.mailboxReadPermission: Applies to the approved read-only MVP scopes; connecting must not start processing. Source adapter must confirm the permission claim remains true.
guards.import.review.destination: Use actual reviewed providers; describe local text parsing as such, never a fabricated vendor.
guards.import.progress.background: Show only after durable Start acceptance, never during incomplete authorization.
guards.drive.offer: Feature enabled, no current archive, and real first value reached or explicit user request.
guards.recurring.change: Feature enabled and a comparable pair of source-backed charges exists.
guards.privacy.pilot: Operator measurement enabled; separate user opt-in, never required to start.
